title: A solution is a mixture that is the same all the way through
summary: A solution, also called a homogeneous mixture, has the same makeup in every drop, as with salt stirred into water.
body: OpenStax Chemistry says a homogeneous mixture, also called a solution, has a uniform composition and looks the same throughout. A sports drink is one example, because each drop tastes the same. Salt dissolved in water, air, maple syrup, and gasoline are others. The page also says the recipe can still vary: a sports drink with a bit more sugar is still a sports drink. Uniform does not mean there is only one allowed recipe. It means a given batch does not change from drop to drop.
